title: Miss Behavin'
html:
Quest Giver: Junior Exec Ivan

Quest Type: Delivery

Quest Description: Find Roh-Zee's Wardrobe on Frump's Misfortune- Level 1 and collect Roh-Zee's Leather Gloves.

Quest Reward: 6250 Gold

Return to: Junior Exec Ivan

Repeatable: No

Tip:Roh'zee's Wardrobe is protected by two Mutant Hulks identified as Roh'zee's Assistants. After you dispatch them you will see the wardrobe in the middle of the room and find the Gloves therein.
